correctionDispositions.basis: Final validation reads actual internal parent/children/terminal/root state. Internal non-virtual detach/attach cannot enter the old parent's public removeChild override between checking and committing.
correctionDispositions.contractRuling: Accepted correction: the existing contract has no implicit mount/remove notification. Successful mount into a live Stage followed by normal shutdown is the proper regression result when the old override is no longer invoked; no new callback requirement is imposed.
behaviorEvidence: R2 atomic reparenting uses internal detach without old-parent override callbacks
correctionDispositions.result: Direct regression passed with overrideCalls=0, live Stage mount and complete later shutdown

correctionDispositions.basis: Scope acceptance treats a closing Engine as rejection even before the Scope itself closes, while checking foreign owner/Engine first, preserving old-value order and cleaning new unowned values before rejection.
behaviorEvidence: R3 open older Scope still cleans an unowned late value while Engine is closing
correctionDispositions.result: Direct regression passed with ENGINE_CLOSED and exactly one release

correctionDispositions.basis: Signal add/post-check failures first deactivate/delete local subscription, then independently attempt adapter rollback. EVENT_SUBSCRIPTION_FAILED retains original cause and rollback cleanupErrors.
behaviorEvidence: R4 failed signal registration rolls back unreachable handler and retains adapter errors
R4 failed post-registration cancellation check also rolls back the local handler
correctionDispositions.result: Both direct regressions passed; failed on calls leave no live unreachable handler

correctionDispositions.basis: Listener cleanup is isolated item by item; container cleanup continues through children; Engine isolates Scope/Stage failures before host stop and bounded close. Existing success-only surface release remains unchanged.
behaviorEvidence: R5 all listener failures and children finish before host close with aggregated causes
R5 listener failure still reaches bounded host close and retains ownership until success
correctionDispositions.result: Both direct regressions passed with ordered causes, child/sibling cleanup, host stop/close, bounded deadline and continued quarantine until successful host completion
